# Graphsong

> Hear the shape of a function. Graphsong turns math equations and CSV tables into stereo Web Audio and plain-English spoken descriptions for blind and low-vision students.

## Key Pages
- `/` — Overview, how it works, who it helps, FAQ
- `/app` — Interactive math sonification player, compare mode, derivative audio, 6 guided lessons
- `/accessibility` — Keyboard shortcuts, screen reader support, contrast, and honest limitations
- `/privacy` — Local-only processing policy (no data leaves the browser)
- `/terms` — Educational terms of use
